newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline edges higher with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline edges higher with crude.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices edged higher on Friday in line with modest crude gains, traders said.
"It is extremely quiet this morning but if anything the market is looking a little firmer," said one.
Very prompt Eurograde barges were valued around $220/$221 a tonne fob ARA, $1-$2 up from the last reported deal on Tuesday.
First half January barges were bid about $1 over January swaps which were better bid after Brent crude futures added about 20 cents on strong gas oil and falling U.S. stocks.
Jan Eurograde swaps were talked around $216/$218 a tonne.
